vibe_rationale: Grassroots gravel race open to any bike, a real gravel scene but race-only, with no festival programme.
fit_notes: Endurance riders in an alpine town, a natural home for recovery and hydration messaging; Lifecare Medical Service is already a partner, a health-adjacent precedent. Nine listed partners and a sponsors page make it open, but the field is small and it is a New Zealand event.
